ti.title: ኣይሓፍርን`የ ብማርያም
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ኣይሓፍርን’የ ብማርያም (2)
ስማ እንክጽውዕ ይጸናናዕ
መደበሲተይ ኢለያየ
ስማ ክጽውዕ ኣብ ጊዜ ሓዘን
በጻሒተይ’ያ መጸናንዒት
ኣብ ጊዜ ሽግር ኣብ ጊዜ ጭንቂ
ከማኺ የለን መተዓረቒ
[[/chorus]]

ማርያም(2) በሉ ምእመናን ኵሉ
ማርያም (2) ኢልና ክንድሕን ኢና

ti_ro.title: Ayhafrn`ye bmaryam
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Maryam(2) belu mmenan kwilu
Maryam (2) ilna kndhn ina
Tselayey n-kesaqyeni
Ayteqmn ilu nknqeni
Meleleytey nskhi ikhi
Keydu tefiu ryu slkhi
Maryam(2) belu mmenan kwilu
Maryam (2) ilna kndhn ina
[[/chorus]]

Ayhafrn’ye bmaryam (2)
Sma nktsw ytsenana
Medebesitey ileyaye
Sma ktsw ab gize hazen
Betsahitey’ya metsenanit
Ab gize shgr ab gize chnqi
Kemakhi yelen meteareqi

Kwilu hasabey tejemiruyu
Ytsbelekhu zemen newihu
Ftsame kri dngl rdni
Ylmn alekhu ab afdegekhi
